rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with the provided 2AB label, but the image does not clearly show a large well-defined blastocoel occupying most of the embryo; calling it high-quality/top-tier overstates the morphology, and zona thinning/ICM localization are somewhat speculative from this image.

Integrates age, prior live birth, sperm quality, endometrium, BMI, and diagnosis reasonably well with prognosis, though it overinterprets the AMH/oocyte yield discrepancy and does not fully contextualize tubal factor as favorable once IVF bypasses it.

The structure is logical overall, but there are notable inconsistencies: it labels 2AB as top-tier/high-quality, infers poor response from 11 oocytes despite 10 MII being a good yield, and suggests more aggressive stimulation without clear justification.

Some elements are standard (proceed with transfer, luteal support), but recommending more aggressive stimulation and implying poor response based on this yield are not evidence-based here; suggesting PGT-A because of high AMH/possible PCOS is weakly supported and not guideline-driven for a 32-year-old with this profile.

Provides practical next steps such as proceeding with transfer and maintaining luteal support, but future-cycle advice is only moderately useful because key recommendations are too generic or based on questionable premises.
